statement: BTC returns are positively autocorrelated over 1-4 month horizons (time-series momentum).
mechanism: Slow diffusion of information, herding and leverage cycles in a retail-heavy market (Liu & Tsyvinski 2021 'Risks and Returns of Cryptocurrency').
falsification: TRAIN net Sharpe < 0.5 or residual vs buy&hold-VT < 0.3 for all variants.

sources.title: Liu & Tsyvinski (2021) Risks and Returns of Cryptocurrency, RFS
